设计意图： This factor focuses on where closes settle relative to the broken 20-day high rather than on the breakout move itself. A close far above the old boundary relative to that day's trading range signals strong acceptance of the new level, while a close hugging the boundary signals a weak hold. Averaging over five days makes the signal a durable settlement premium.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(ts_mean(5, I(close > res20) * (close - res20) / (high - low)))
依赖列: high, low, close

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(where((AdjClose > ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20)), divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20)), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)), ), 5)
  2. 2. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((AdjClose > ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20)), divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20)), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)), )
  3. 3. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20)
  4. 4. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20)), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow))
  6. 6. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20))
  7. 7. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1), 20)
  8. 8. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjHigh, 1)
  9. 9. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)

AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 prior_high：high.shift(1).滚动窗口(20).max()
  2. 计算 day_range：(high - low)
  3. 计算 settlement：(close - prior_high) / day_range
  4. 计算 premium：np.where(close > prior_high, settlement, 0.0)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_boundary_settlement_premium_5d_20d_high(df): """Idea: Where closes settle relative to the broken 20-day high reveals whether the new level is being held; closes that finish well above the old boundary ">class="kw">in the day's range indicate stronger acceptance. Logic: For each day with close above the prior 20-day high, express the close minus that resistance "kw">class="kw">in units of the day's high-low range. Average this settlement premium over 5 days, "kw">class="kw">and assign zero on days when price is "kw">class="kw">not above the old boundary. Formula: mean_5( I(close > res20) * (close - res20) / (high - low) ) Sub-mechanism tags: settlement premium, upper-bound hold, close-location relative to resistance. """ df_copy = df.copy() prior_high = df_copy["high"].shift(1).rolling(20).max() day_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).replace(0.0, np.nan) settlement = (df_copy["close"] - prior_high) / day_range premium = np.where(df_copy["close"] > prior_high, settlement, 0.0) df_copy["factor_boundary_settlement_premium_5d_20d_high"] = pd.Series(premium, index=df_copy.index).rolling(5).mean() "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_boundary_settlement_premium_5d_20d_high"]
